title: Storm Sorceress with Owl
description: An elven sorceress with long flowing white hair and ornate jewelry floats dynamically in a stormy sky, wielding a glowing blue magical staff that emits swirling energy trails. A small glowing turquoise owl with large eyes flies beside her, surrounded by swirling blue mists, cherry blossoms, falling petals, and dark shadowy figures against a dramatic purple and turquoise cloudy backdrop.
